reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) does not directly support the key premises. E1 shows Mn forms non-protective oxides in CrMnFeCoNi, but only up to 900 °C and without comparison to Al or Si variants. E2 concerns AlCoCrFeNi coatings, a different composition and processing route, and does not address the CrFeCoNiX system or the specific oxide coherence/lattice mismatch claims. The hypothesis overstates the support from these sources.
premises: Al (or Si) in CrFeCoNiX forms a slow-growing, dense, coherent Al2O3 or silica-based oxide above 900 °C
Mn in CrFeCoNiX forms rapidly growing, porous, non-protective manganese oxides above 900 °C
The protective character is governed by diffusion kinetics of the X element
The protective character is governed by phase stability and lattice mismatch of the oxide scale
CrFeCoNiX with Al/Si will show adherent, protective scales, while Mn alloys will show cracking/spallation
